name: sky130-ldo
description: Loom-managed workspace with AI development orchestration

scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && ./.loom/scripts/check-xschem-embedded-quotes.sh && ./.loom/scripts/check-xschem-duplicate-instance-names.sh && ./.loom/scripts/check-dr-numbering.sh --self-test && ./.loom/scripts/check-dr-numbering.sh && ./.loom/scripts/check-evidence-append-only.sh --self-test && ./.loom/scripts/check-evidence-append-only.sh && npm run check:characterization && npm run check:spec-status
scripts.test: npm run test:compile && npm run test:lint-py && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:lint-py: git ls-files -z -- '*.py' ':!.loom' ':!.claude' | xargs -0 uvx --from ruff==0.17.0 ruff check --isolated --no-cache --select F
scripts.test:compile: find sim layout measurements signoff -name '*.py' -not -path 'layout/.venv*/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 python3 -m py_compile
scripts.test:unit: python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory sim/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory measurements/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory layout/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory signoff/tests --pattern 'test_*.py'
scripts.lint: find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*.json' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 python3 -m json.tool > /dev/null && find sim layout measurements signoff -name '*.json' -not -path 'layout/.venv*/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 python3 -m json.tool > /dev/null && git ls-files -z -- '*.sh' ':!.loom' ':!.claude' | xargs -0 -n1 bash -n
